transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Monitor status activity is written for child threads only. turn/started sets activityKind responding, active true, line Subagent turn running. turn/completed sets active false and omits the line.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: Child items use reasoning for reasoning, responding for agentMessage or userMessage, and tool for every other item type. Lines are fixed strings.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: Root turn status is not a monitor status upsert. The pipeline turn normalizer emits turn events on the agent-event channel.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: actorState maps pendingInit, running, active, and inProgress to active; idle to idle; interrupted, completed, errored, shutdown, notFound, and closed to stopped; anything else to unknown.
